title: विकास योजनामा जनसहभागिता : एक अध्ययन Bikas Yojanama Jansahabhagita: Ek Adhyayan
nepali: साधारण अर्थमा जनसहभागिता भन्नाले आफू बसेको क्षेत्रको दैनिक व्यवहारमाजनताको संलग्नता भन्ने बुझिन्छ, जसले उनीहरूको दैनिक जीवनमा प्रभाव पार्दछ ।सेवाग्राहीहरूबीच हुने शक्तिको बाँडफाँड नै वास्तवमा सहभागिता हो । यदि शक्तिकोबाँडफाँड समान रूपमा हुँदैन र समाजको कुनै एक हिस्सासँग अर्को हिस्सासँगभन्दा बढीशक्ति केन्द्रित हुन्छ भने त्यसलाई वास्तविक अर्थमा सहभागिता भनिदैन । योजना निर्माणर निर्णय प्रक्रियामा जनसहभागिता विना स्थानीय आवश्यकताहरूको बारेमा सम्बोधनसम्भव छैन । यसै सन्दर्भमा यस लेखले चिती गा.वि.स. का जनताको विकास योजनामासहभागिताको बारेमा विश्लेषण गर्ने कोसिस भएको छ । प्राथमिक स्रोतबाट प्राप्ततथ्याङ्कहरूको विश्लेषणबाट प्राप्त निष्कर्षहरूको आधारमा के भन्न सकिन्छ भने यसचिती गा.वि.स. मा जनसहभागितामूलक विकास कार्यलाई थप अभिवृद्धि गर्नको लागिसहभागिताका लागि हुने लगानीभन्दा फाइदा बढी हुन्छ भन्ने अनुभूति जनतालाईदिलाउन सक्नुपर्छ । आयोजनाहरूको निर्माण र मर्मत सम्भारमा महिलाहरूको सहभागिताप्रशस्त मात्रामा भए पनि निर्णय प्रक्रियामा अझै पनि उनीहरूलाई आवश्यक अनुपातमासंलग्न गराउन सकिएको छैन । त्यसकारण आयोजनाको छनोट र लाभको विवरणसम्बन्धीनिर्णय गर्दा महिलाहरूको निश्चित संख्या उपस्थित हुनै पर्ने प्रावधान राख्नु पर्छ ।
american_english: In a general sense, people's participation is understood to mean the involvement of the people in the everyday practices of the area they live in, which affects their daily lives. The distribution of power among service users is what participation actually is. If power is not distributed equally and more power is concentrated with one section of society than with another, that is not called participation in the true sense. Without people's participation in the planning and decision-making process, it is not possible to address local needs. In this very context, this article has attempted to analyse the participation of the people of Chiti VDC in development plans. Based on the conclusions drawn from the analysis of data obtained from primary sources, it can be said that in this Chiti VDC, in order to further promote participation-based development work, the people must be made to feel that the benefit outweighs the investment made for participation. Although women's participation in the construction and maintenance of projects has been substantial, they have still not been able to be involved in the decision-making process in the required proportion. Therefore, when decisions are made about the selection of projects and the details of the benefits, there must be a provision requiring a fixed number of women to be present.
british_english: In the ordinary sense, public participation means the involvement of people in the daily affairs of the area in which they live, and this affects their everyday lives. It is the distribution of power among service users that is participation in the true sense. If power is not shared out equally, and more power is concentrated with one section of society than another, then that cannot be called participation in the true sense. Without public participation in the process of plan-making and decision-making, local needs cannot be addressed. In this very context, this article has sought to analyse the participation of the people of Chiti VDC in development plans. On the basis of the conclusions reached from the analysis of data obtained from primary sources, what can be said is that in this Chiti VDC, in order to further promote participation-based development work, the people must be brought to feel that the benefit is greater than the investment made for participation. Although women's participation in the construction and maintenance of projects has been considerable, they have still not been enabled to take part in the decision-making process in the required proportion. For that reason, when decisions are taken on the selection of projects and the details of benefits, provision must be made for a fixed number of women to be present.
australian_english: In a general sense, community participation means people getting involved in the day-to-day goings-on of the area they live in, and that has an impact on their daily lives. The sharing out of power among the people using the services is what participation really comes down to. If the power isn't shared out evenly, and one part of society ends up with more power than another, then that's not participation in any real sense. Without community participation in the planning and decision-making process, you can't really address local needs. In this very context, this article has had a go at analysing the participation of the people of Chiti VDC in development plans. Based on the conclusions drawn from analysing the data gathered from primary sources, the takeaway is that here in Chiti VDC, if you want to give participation-based development work a further boost, you've got to make people feel that the payoff is bigger than what they put in to take part. Even though women have pitched in heavily in building and maintaining projects, they still haven't been brought into the decision-making process in the numbers needed. So when it comes to picking projects and sorting out the benefit details, there's got to be a rule that a set number of women are in the room.

From the conclusions drawn out of the data gathered from primary sources, the takeaway is that here in Chiti VDC, if you want to give participation-based development work a proper boost, you've got to make people feel the payoff is bigger than what they put in to take part. Women have pitched in heavily in building and maintaining projects, but they still haven't been brought into the decision-making process in the numbers needed. So when it comes to picking projects and sorting out the benefit details, there's got to be a rule that a set number of women are in the room.
